g.text: Ten CIM technologies in the ρ–τ plane

text.tspan: Linear axes throughout · Numerical slope from the origin: =/=RI · Rates in decimal MB/s

g.text: Colors identify technologies. Labels report typical RI* in A–C; D lists typical (τ, ρ). Thin connections only associate paired scenarios.
† Gain-cell long is a refresh stress point (3.93% availability), shown separately without an ordinary-range connection. Its typical point includes refresh.
B and C preserve geometric slopes: the k = 1 line is 45°. A and D expand one axis for visibility; judge balance against the dashed line, not its visual angle.
